channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: 7 Cambodian workers deported from Vietnam for illegal employment
item.description: Police in Dong Nai Province, southern Vietnam on Tuesday confirmed that they had deported seven Cambodian nationals who were found working illegally at a local business in Chon Thanh Ward.

item.title: Vietnam’s An Giang approves use of protective forest land for Phu Quoc airport expansion
item.description: Vietnam’s An Giang Province on Tuesday approved a resolution to convert 0.46 hectares of protective forest land for use in expanding Phu Quoc International Airport, part of broader regional infrastructure development linked to tourism and transport planning.

item.title: Foreign tourists, locals queue in Hanoi for premium Japanese matcha despite high prices
item.description: Foreign tourists and local customers lined up in central Hanoi this week for a newly opened Japanese matcha brand offering drinks priced well above the city’s typical range.

item.title: Vietnam ministry proposes higher food rations, annual health checks for prisoners
item.description: Vietnam’s Ministry of Public Security has proposed increasing food rations for prisoners, including a 50-percent rise in monthly meat and fish allowances, the addition of eggs, and mandatory annual health check-ups, according to a draft decree released for public consultation.

item.title: Traditional junks return to Vietnam’s Ha Long Bay, stir memories, tourism hopes
item.description: Traditional three-sail junks once familiar to generations of Vietnamese through school textbooks have reappeared in Ha Long Bay, northern Quang Ninh Province, drawing attention from residents and visitors and marking a rare return of a sailboat long absent from the UNESCO-listed site.

item.title: Ten dead after woman opens fire at high school in Canada
item.description: Ten people are dead including the shooter after a woman opened fire at a high school in western Canada on Tuesday before turning the gun on herself, police said.

item.title: Air New Zealand cancels long-haul services as cabin crew strike looms
item.description: Air New Zealand said on Wednesday it had cancelled 46 wide-body long-haul services ahead of a planned two-day strike by cabin crew over stalled negotiations.

item.title: India tightens grip on social media with new three-hour takedown rule
item.description: NEW DELHI - India's government said social media companies would have to take down unlawful content within three hours of being notified about it, tightening on Tuesday an earlier 36-hour timeline in what could be a compliance challenge for Meta, YouTube and X.

item.title: Luxury hotels in Ho Chi Minh City draw crowds with all-inclusive Tet experiences
item.description: As the 2026 Lunar New Year holiday, or Tet, approaches, four- and five-star hotels in Ho Chi Minh City are seizing the golden opportunity to attract both local and international visitors with all-inclusive festive experiences.
